record.question: Increase in concentration of a toxicant at successive trophic level is called
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: Biomagnification is an increase in a chemical’s concentration as it moves to higher trophic levels, commonly through dietary transfer. EPA’s definition matches the stem. This describes a pattern for chemicals capable of biomagnifying; it is not universal for every toxicant.
